title: Placeholder expansion in burn --purpose (CLI + TUI)
brief: Expand {utc_time} => 'DD-MM-YY HH:MM:SSZ' and {utc_timestamp} => u64 text in the purpose string before signing, in both pwm-cli and pwm-tui burn paths.
notes: Orchestrator 2026-05-06: small UX feature. No new dependencies (std only). Shared helper in pwm-core or as a tiny module in each crate. CLI: expand before set_burn_purpose_signed. TUI: expand in burn_form submit path. pwm-coding: implemented placeholder expansion for {utc_time}/{utc_timestamp} in CLI and TUI before burn purpose signing; added unit tests in pwm-cli.
